author: j3st3r.sol
content:
Question for privacy folks building on Privacy Pools: we've been using the processooor field as an adapter hook. A withdrawal is spent by a small contract (bound in the proof context) that e.g. pays an ENS-resolved zk.money deposit address, or funds a zkAPI note from a fresh browser-held key, so the zkAPI vault deposit has no wallet history.

Two open questions:
1. Is there interest in a standard adapter interface (recipient / minOut / deadline / fee in the withdrawal data) so wallets like Kohaku could support "spend via adapter" generically?
2. zkAPI deposits carry a Merkle path to the next leaf, so they race. Has anyone seen a cleaner pattern than client-side rebuild + resend?
